class.name: FmodBank
class.brief_description: A loaded FMOD Studio bank containing audio content and metadata.

method.name: get_bus_count
method.description: Returns the number of buses defined in this bank.

method.name: get_bus_list
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodBus] objects defined in this bank.

method.name: get_description_list
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodEventDescription] objects defined in this bank.

method.name: get_event_description_count
method.description: Returns the number of event descriptions defined in this bank.

method.name: get_godot_res_path
method.description: Returns the Godot resource path (e.g. [code]"res://audio/Music.bank"[/code]) that was used to load this bank.

method.name: get_guid
method.description: Returns the GUID of this bank as a string.

method.name: get_loading_state
method.description: Returns the current loading state of the bank as an [code]FMOD_STUDIO_LOADING_STATE[/code] integer: [code]0[/code] = Unloading, [code]1[/code] = Unloaded, [code]2[/code] = Loading, [code]3[/code] = Loaded, [code]4[/code] = Error.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the FMOD Studio path of this bank (e.g. [code]"bank:/Music"[/code]).

method.name: get_string_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in the bank's string table. The strings bank provides human-readable names for events, buses, and VCAs.

method.name: get_vca_count
method.description: Returns the number of VCAs defined in this bank.

method.name: get_vca_list
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodVCA] objects defined in this bank.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying FMOD bank handle is still valid.
